description: Main React component for a simple notes application, managing note list, detail view, editing, creation, and deletion.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a string.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component for the notes app, handling state, effects, and UI rendering.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific note by ID.

methods.name: beginCreate
methods.description: Initiates creation mode for a new note.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Enters edit mode for the selected note.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing or creation, reverting to view mode.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft as a new or updated note via API.

methods.name: deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the selected note after confirmation.

methods.name: selectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by ID for viewing.
